BrochureContent.Content:
Michael Pigott Auctioneer & Valuer proudly brings to the market for sale this delightful two bedroom townhouse situated in an exclusive seven-house scheme in Bandon, which is beautifully enclosed within the19th-century stone walls of the old abattoir, meat and fish market known as The Shambles.

This property offers spacious accommodation throughout with a welcoming entrance hall, large open plan kitchen/dining/living room, utility area and guest WC. Upstairs, it has two spacious double bedrooms, 1 en suite and main bathroom. It is in superb condition throughout, having been very well cared for and presented by its current owner. It is superbly finished to the highest of standards with high quality fixtures and fittings evident throughout such as a modern fitted kitchen with integrated appliances, solid wooden flooring, fully tiled bathrooms to name just a few. It also features extensive glazing and roof lights to the kitchen area that allows lots of natural light flow right through the ground floor.

The property boasts an enclosed rear yard that offers excellent privacy and to the front, enjoys access to lovely communal courtyard area that is superbly landscaped and maintained. 
 
It is most conveniently within walking distance to all amenities and services in Bandon town centre, and is just a short commute to Cork City Centre & Cork Airport.

Viewing of this ideal starter home or trader down property in a hugely convenient position comes highly recommended.

Size: 79.4 sq metres (855 sq ft)
Gas Fired Central Heating 
PVC Double Glazed Windows & Doors 
Enclosed rear yard
Ready for immediate occupation 
Immaculate condition throughout
Secure gated complex
Within walking distance to all amenities & services in Bandon town
Short commute to Cork City Centre & Cork Airport
Easy access to a regular public bus service

From the Cork direction coming into Bandon town, turn right at the T-junction after you pass Kellehers Topline Hardware. Continue over the bridge and follow the road to the left heading for Dunmanway/Bantry. Pass Bandon Courthouse & Ray O' Mahony's Bar on the left handside and you will see the high stone wall on the right handside, which is The Shambles. Follow Eircode: P72 FE06
